## Before you update to 0.10.0

Version 0.10.0 uses a new vault format and cannot open a vault from 0.9.x by itself. This version moves your data for you when you update from inside the app.

### Update from inside the app (recommended)

1. Open **Settings > About** and click **Download update**, or click **Download** in the update notification. This version only offers 0.10.0, even when a newer version exists.
2. Unlock the vault if it is locked.
3. Click **Restart to update**. The app saves your data for the new format, then restarts into 0.10.0.
4. In 0.10.0, unlock the vault with your usual master password. Your accounts, tags, favorite places, and settings move over automatically.

> [!WARNING]
> Only update by hand if the app does not offer 0.10.0. If you update by hand, download **0.10.0** from its release page, even when the latest release is newer, and export your data first:
>
> 1. In this version, open **Settings > Vault > Export data**, choose a passcode, and save the file.
> 2. Replace this app with 0.10.0 and open it.
> 3. Click **Set aside old vault**, then create a new vault.
> 4. Open **Add account > Import export file** and select your file.
